conventions.units: Metres unless explicitly stated otherwise. Screen dimensions are separate from auditorium dimensions.

conventions.equipment: Installed equipment does not guarantee the format of an individual performance. Venue-wide reports are labelled as such.
conventions.images: Source-captioned numbered rooms, visible entrance numbers, and inferred candidates are distinguished. confirmed_room establishes source identity, not current appearance. Entrances and drawings are not auditorium interior photos.
conventions.historical: Historical dossier data does not fill current unknown values.
